objective: Specify independent and coupled oracle batches so a response to one decision cannot silently authorize another.
assumptions: Each decision item has a stable identity
Coupled items declare their dependency explicitly
unknowns: Oracle workload and batching benefit require evaluation
invariants: An item response authorizes only its declared item set
Independent items do not inherit responses
Coupled dependencies are visible in the packet
acceptance_predicates: Single-item, independent, and coupled fixtures are distinguishable
A partial response cannot complete an unanswered item
Batch relation is persisted with the decision
